title: Hotel world
content: I’m trying to see if anyone else has had a similar dream/experience. Possibly advice on how to got out of this loop? Several times a month I have multiple vivid dreams about being in a hotel staircase that’s never ending. There are two separate stair cases that always take you to different parts of the hotel if you run fast enough but I’m always stuck on the stairs running from something or trying to find something. A few times I have had to “kill”someone very violently, but they are either someone who caused me a lot of harm or someone with no face that’s blurred and mixed around. I can only ever go in three room and never leave the floor, one door leads me outside, the other to my childhood home and the last to a school I don’t recognize, but I’m always stuck on that floor. I can use the glass elevator but it goes no where, I stay put but it looks like it’s moving. The stairs in the hotel are completely maroon and the walls are ruby painted, the ceiling is like a black design.It’s always very dimly lit and it causes headaches in my dreams but I don’t wake up with them. I can always control what I’m doing but I can’t control when I have these dreams. I was pulled out of classes a lot as a kid for “testing” but I was never in the gate program that my mom’s knows of. I barely remember my childhood in school unless something triggers that memory.
